dict.string: OrbitDeck connects to a Bluetooth Low Energy serial adapter to Doppler-tune your radio (CAT control). It is used only when you configure and connect a radio.
OrbitDeck connects to your radio, rotator, or a rigctld/rotctld server over your local Wi-Fi network to control it. It is used only when you configure and connect a network device.

OrbitDeck captures the received satellite audio from a connected USB audio interface (which iOS treats as a microphone) to record passes and decode SSTV and FT4. Audio is used only while you record or decode.
OrbitDeck can save decoded SSTV images to your photo library when you choose to export them.
